cards.subtitle: Deterministic Sébastien Lagarde (2011) roughness-attenuated ambient/IBL grazing Fresnel (F_Lagarde = F0 + (max(1 - alpha, F0) - F0) * (1 - N·V)^5, attenuating the grazing specular ceiling as 1 - alpha so total grazing rim energy E_rim = (1 - alpha) + alpha locks at exact 1.0000x across all 17 roughness stations alpha in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 glowing-rim stations) versus naive un-attenuated Schlick IBL Fresnel (F0 + (1 - F0)*(1 - N·V)^5, which forces 100% mirror reflection at N·V = 0 regardless of surface roughness alpha, inflating total grazing rim energy as 1 + alpha to 1.2500x at alpha=0.25, 1.5000x at alpha=0.50, and 2.0000x / +100% radioactive white rim halo at alpha=1.00 across 16/17 rough stations) and 64-stratum microfacet slope quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Ambient / Image-Based Lighting (IBL) specular Fresnel evaluation where half-vector H is unavailable and N·V is used
Rough dielectric materials (clay, concrete, cloth, matte skin, dry mud) preventing glowing white silhouette halos
Screen-space reflection (SSR) and reflection probe blending weights at grazing camera angles
Single-line clamp F0 + (max(vec3(1.0 - roughness), F0) - F0) * pow(1.0 - NdotV, 5.0)
not_for: Direct analytical point/directional light BRDFs that already evaluate Fresnel with exact microfacet half-vector V·H and Smith G2 masking
